_note: Verordeningenregister (local regulations register) — appended onto the bundled src/manifest.json by main.js::mergeManifestFragments (ADR-037). Index + detail pages for the regeling register plus a regeling-versie detail page; schema refs BY SLUG (regeling / regeling-versie), never the PascalCase keys Regeling / RegelingVersie (multi-word schema — the exact silent-breakage case). DECLARATIVE CORE only: the public register page of regelingen in force (REQ-VOR-005) is served by the OpenRegister published-predicate (authorization.read match status in-werking on the regeling/regeling-versie schemas), NOT by a manifest page — mirroring the toezegging/bevoegdheidstoedeling siblings which ship no public manifest page. The 'geldend op' (in-force-on-date) date control and the version timeline (REQ-VOR-004/008) are wired by the imperative RegelingConsolidationService slice; this fragment provides the declarative page skeleton, quick filters on type/status, and the version-timeline placeholder via the Related widget. The RegelingExportPackage build/deliver UI (REQ-VOR-006) is the deferred imperative slice — no export-package manifest page ships here.

config._note: Regelingen index (REQ-VOR-008). Columns citeertitel/type/vaststellendOrgaan/currentInwerkingtreding/status/cvdrIdentifier; quick filters on type and status, full-text search over citeertitel. currentInwerkingtreding renders the current-version date from the convenience field (maintained by RegelingConsolidationService, no per-row N+1). CSV export via the shared ExportService + CnMassExportDialog. The public register of regelingen in force (REQ-VOR-005) is not this page — it is the OpenRegister published-predicate surface (status in-werking).

RegelingDetail (REQ-VOR-004/008). Regeling metadata leads 8-wide, publication/CVDR stacked right; the linked vaststellendOrgaan renders as a resolved reference in the data + Related widgets. The Related widget surfaces the version timeline — every RegelingVersie (via its regeling ref) with versienummer, inwerkingtreding, state and its wijzigingsbesluit link to the Decision detail page — plus the current in-force version. The 'geldend op' date control driving REQ-VOR-004 resolution and the per-version export/publication state are wired by the imperative RegelingConsolidationService / RegelingExportService slices; this fragment provides the declarative skeleton. Files leaf for supporting documents. Audit trail is a sidebar tab.

RegelingVersieDetail (REQ-VOR-002/003). Version metadata leads 8-wide; the linked regeling (parent work) and vastgesteldDoor (wijzigingsbesluit Decision) render as resolved references in the data + Related widgets — the amending-decision link navigates to the existing Decision detail page (REQ-VOR-008). The consolidated-text document is the Files leaf (attached via the OR file abstraction, not a schema property). Once the version is in-werking it is sealed and immutable (REQ-VOR-003) — the seal is enforced server-side by OpenRegister, independent of this UI. Audit trail is a sidebar tab.
